reviews.review:
EDF5 is the best game in the series so far. It functions as a reboot, so you needn't have played past games, but the improvements are cool to see. Selecting from four classes, all of whom have new tweaks, and then hopping online to take on scores of missions in 4-player co-op is super fun. 

EDF games have always been about clearing missions on multiple difficulty levels and collecting hundreds of weapons as random drops. Picking up duplicate weapons now upgrades existing weapons, which makes them more useful and adds to the addictiveness. 

Playing solo is a good way to build up your characters and farm stuff, and you can even do 2-player split-screen (though split-screen players can't join online games). If you enjoy cooperative action and B-movie sci-fi atmosphere, this games will easily keep you busy for more than a hundred hours. Don't miss it!

Note: I got the Steam version for review, but I purchased the PlayStation 4 version myself and have been having a blast playing through again on Steam.

Earth Defense Force 5 is, no exaggeration, the most fun co-op game on all of Steam. I highly recommend buying it if you can muster up two or three long-time friends and agree to all play as different classes.

The game is quite lengthy thanks to an incredibly huge number of levels, yet for me it just never lost steam. Between the seemingly endless amount of equipable items I kept unlocking, playing on Hard for my first playthrough so that it never got too easy, and a variety of enemies always being used in different environments, quantities, and combinations, I just never got tired of it.

The plot of EDF5 is actually really dark when you think about it, but it's stylized like a Kaiju B-moive, complete with a charmingly sloppy English dub, overly quirky characters, bright colors, campy tropes, and utterly ridiculous-looking enemies. The developers could not possibly have flavored this over-the-top cartoon violence better than they did.

MONSTERS! ALIENS! GIANT ROBOTS!
SPECTACULAR B-MOVIE ACTION!

Enlist now YOU WON'T REGRET IT!
Endless hours of alien and bug carnage. Bring a friend.
